title: HSBC UK enhances Premier proposition with up to £790 in cashback and premium travel benefits for eligible new customers - About HSBC | HSBC UK

headings.text: HSBC UK enhances Premier proposition with up to £790 in cashback and premium travel benefits for eligible new customers

body: Share link to this page on X
Share link to this page on Facebook
Share link to this page on LinkedIn
28 July 2026
Eligible customers can receive a £500 Welcome Reward when opening an HSBC Premier Bank Account
Customers taking out an HSBC Premier World Elite Mastercard can also receive £290 cashback, effectively offsetting the card’s annual fee in the first year
HSBC Premier World Elite Mastercard customers benefit from premium travel perks including complimentary airport lounge access and fast-track security at selected airports

Earlier this year, HSBC UK launched a £500 Premier Welcome Reward for eligible customers opening an HSBC Premier Bank Account. The offer is available to new customers who either complete a full Current Account Switch Service (CASS) switch and pay in an annual salary of at least £100,000, or deposit and maintain £100,000 or more in savings and investments with HSBC UK.
HSBC Premier World Elite Mastercard offer

The Premier proposition has now been enhanced even further. Customers who successfully apply for an HSBC Premier World Elite Mastercard can receive a further £290 cashback, effectively offsetting the card’s annual fee in the first year, bringing the total value of the welcome package to up to £790.

Alongside the cashback, the HSBC Premier World Elite Mastercard offers customers a range of premium travel benefits designed to make every journey smoother and more rewarding. These include complimentary airport lounge access, fast-track security at selected airports, accelerated reward points and a host of travel privileges, giving customers greater value every time they travel.

The enhanced proposition reflects HSBC UK’s continued investment in its Premier offering, combining premium banking, wealth expertise and travel benefits to help customers get more from their banking.
Introduction of digital appointment bookings

As part of this ongoing commitment to offering stand-out customer service, HSBC UK has also introduced digital appointment bookings. Relationship Manager (RM) and Premier Financial Consultant (PFC)-managed Premier customers can now easily book appointments through the HSBC UK Mobile Banking app.

The new feature enables eligible customers to book, amend or cancel review appointments directly in the app, choosing whether to meet face-to-face, by phone or via Zoom, making it easier than ever to access personalised support and advice at a time that suits.
Carl Watchorn, Head of Premier Banking at HSBC UK, said:

“Our Premier customers want a banking relationship that works harder for them, whether that’s managing their day-to-day finances, growing their wealth or making the most of travel and lifestyle benefits.

“This enhanced welcome offer rewards customers who choose to bring more of their financial world to HSBC, while introducing them to everything our Premier proposition has to offer. Customers who choose the HSBC Premier World Elite Mastercard can enjoy premium travel benefits such as complimentary airport lounge access and fast-track security, alongside market-leading rewards that make travelling easier and more rewarding.”

In addition to the Welcome Reward, HSBC Premier customers benefit from dedicated relationship management, international banking support, access to wealth services and a range of travel and lifestyle benefits. Customers who choose the HSBC Premier World Elite Mastercard also enjoy premium travel privileges, including complimentary airport lounge access, fast-track security at selected airports and accelerated reward points.

Notes to editors:
HSBC UK

HSBC UK serves over 15 million active customers across the UK, supported by 23,800 colleagues. HSBC UK offers a complete range of retail banking and wealth management to personal and private banking customers, as well as commercial banking for small to medium businesses and large corporates. HSBC UK is a ring-fenced bank and wholly owned subsidiary of HSBC Holdings plc.
HSBC Holdings plc

HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of HSBC, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 56 countries and territories. With assets of US$3,306bn on 31 March 2026, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations.
